corrected_findings.finding: Initial extractor resolved source paths but did not validate output redirection. A private SDD/tab-core directory junction caused writes outside the supplied fixture root.
corrected_findings.reproduction: Initial private output_junction fixture wrote extracted documents, reading copy and inventory into escape-sink. No shared original or output was affected.
corrected_findings.correction: Coordinator added validate_output_tree before extraction; it validates root and every existing descendant against the intended lexical/resolved output path.
corrected_findings.verification: Fresh timestamped root-junction and documents-descendant-junction cases now reject before helper writes; registered-only golden case remains successful.

limits: PDF comparison shares underlying PyMuPDF extraction semantics; it establishes reproducibility of extracted blocks/candidate tables, not verified visual reading order or correct table interpretation.
DOCX XML preservation is not page-layout fidelity, numbering/field reconstruction, image interpretation or semantic acceptance.
Original DOCX has no tracked edits; revision behavior was verified with a synthetic source.
Existing output path checks do not provide operating-system isolation against adversarial concurrent filesystem replacement. No such concurrency test or claim is made.
